results.title: Holiday Unplugged
results.overview: Sally, an art teacher, has spent the last 10 years honoring the memory of her late husband, Jake, while raising their children, Keegan and Boo. Feeling like she’s finally ready for love, she joins a dating app and is matched with Damon, her former colleague who taught her kids’ kindergarten class. Jake had co-founded a web platform that preserved family home videos. When a server migration wipes out Sally’s treasured videos of him – and her phone containing backup copies accidentally shatters – the only hope is finding the original tapes. She doesn’t want Keegan and Boo to know about the missing videos so to buy time until they’re recovered, Sally institutes a screen-free Christmas for her family while secretly searching for the tapes.

results.title: The Last Round
results.overview: Lana Reyes, once a very prominent MMA fighter, made the decision to walk away from a successful career in order to have a family. After raising her son alone, she decided to step back in to the cage to do the one thing she knew how to do. FIGHT. On the night of her comeback fight, after a brutal two rounds, she shakily steps into the third round with a fractured hand a potentially career ending TBI. She shakily steps forward and by the grace of god sees an opening that only instincts would see that ends up winning her the fight. 3 months later, before properly healing up, she takes another fight. Her interactions with her Cut man, Manager and the Commission Doctor lead her to the decision of choosing between walking out injured --- or walking away from the sport before it takes everything she has left.

results.title: Ghosts of the Gold Rush
results.overview: From the creators of Haunted Discoveries, Ghosts of the Gold Rush explores California’s darkest Gold Rush legends, from Hangtown’s violent past to a deadly mining disaster and asks whether history can leave something behind that never truly dies.

results.title: The Trans Girl Next Door
results.original_title: となりのとらんす少女ちゃん
results.overview: Yuta, a second-year middle school student, lives with his single mother. One day, a woman named Yuka suddenly appears at Yuta’s home. Yuka claims to be Yuta himself, having come from 10 years in the future—after enduring various hardships, he underwent gender confirmation surgery to become who she is now. Yuka urges Yuta to begin the process of gender transition as soon as possible, before he reaches adulthood. Although Yuta had begun to feel a slight sense of dissonance among his friends, he resists Yuka’s forceful pressure. A tug-of-war ensues between Yuka, who has chosen to live as a woman, and Yuta, who finds it difficult to accept that future.

results.title: Monero
results.overview: A story based on true events and dedicated to the Mexican cartoonist RIUS.  In 1968 Mexico City, Mancha—a cartoonist for the magazine "La Garrapata"—battles government censorship of his work under Gustavo Díaz Ordaz, while one of his own cartoon characters manifests in the real world, urging him to be brave and fight for what he believes in.

results.title: Moonless Night in a Coal Mine
results.original_title: Notte senza luna in una miniera di carbone
results.overview: Among brief on-screen texts and hilarious sound design, total darkness becomes the protagonist of a short film that is as minimalist as it is ironic.

results.title: Résonance
results.overview: Lily, a young actress, loses her grip on reality when she discovers that her neighbor looks exactly like her—feature for feature.

results.title: As Long As It Snows
results.overview: As a child, Margo witnesses her best friend vanish into a snowstorm, marking her for life. Twenty years later, now a teacher, one of her students vanishes under similar circumstances. During the search, she meets a man who bears an unsettling resemblance to her childhood friend.

results.title: Evanescent
results.overview: A young girl makes a bid for connection with her emotionally unavailable father.

results.title: Smile of a single Flower
results.overview: Ottrai Poovin Punnagai (Smile of a Single Flower)' captures the life of Rajalakshmi Senthilkumar, a Bharatanatyam teacher in Chennai, through the eyes of her son. While it celebrates her role as a mentor, it also reveals the simple, beautiful moments of a small girl whose life blossomed through dance, passion, and devotion. A gentle, intimate portrait of a life lived with grace and love.

results.title: The Crack
results.overview: Religious rift enters into a small group of Hijras and threatens to break the tradition of a centuries old marginal practice. However, compassion wins in the end.

results.title: Odium Zero
results.overview: 14 days ago, a comet ripped across the sky, unleashing the disaster now known as the Grayfall. Within hours, parasitic spores called Gray Matters transformed people into savage monsters known as Spikers, collapsing society overnight. Governments sealed off infected cities, buried the truth, and left the outbreak zones to rot. 16-year-old influencer Mai, refusing to believe the official story, breaks into Central Hospital—the outbreak’s ground zero—with her AI cobot, BooBoo. Inside, fear spreads faster than the infection as survivors turn on each other. After rescuing a little girl named Anna, Mai fights to escape a hospital overrun by Spikers. Her path collides with Ren Cade, a ruthless black-ops commander hunting her, while Dr. Theodore secretly pulls the strings from mission control. But Theodore has one more ace up his sleeve: Ares, a genetically engineered killing machine built for one job—and one job only: to take Mai down.

results.title: Slava
results.overview: Karlsruhe, Germany, 1962. KGB agent Bogdan Stashynskii is trialed for the assasination of Ukrainian revolutionary and head of the now disbanded Organization of Ukrainian Nationalists, Stepan Bandera. However, Slava Stetsko and her spouse Yaroslav decide to take action and turn the trial into not just a memorial for Bandera, but a  thorough critique of the USSR's web of political assasinations  and the political indifference to the situation in the West.

results.title: Animal Justice
results.overview: Nick Morgan, a dedicated National Park Ranger, with a passion for wildlife takes a dark turn when he witnesses a brutal act of animal abuse. Nick embarks on a clandestine mission to protect these vulnerable creatures Will he find a way?

results.title: Pactum
results.overview: Six high-society women gather in a mansion bound by a secret pact, a pact one of them has broken and whose consequences will be disastrous. Who is the traitor?

results.title: Red Ink
results.overview: In post-WWII New York, media propaganda, institutional power, and exploitation are interrogated amid the looming threat of a mysterious global virus.

results.title: Larnaca
results.overview: After embarking on a sailing trip on the way to their wedding in Larnaca, Ruth and Yona find themselves stranded at sea with no wind in their sails. As they wait for conditions to change, Ruth's past resurfaces.

results.title: To The Front
results.overview: On Driving Ukraine's 51st convoy, a group of volunteers drive five donated vehicles from Oxfordshire to Lviv, where the keys will be handed over to Ukrainian defenders. Among the group are a Cornish farmer, a Ukrainian evacuee, and one of the writers of Ace Ventura: Pet Detective.

results.title: Kinship
results.overview: Embark on a global journey, with a seasoned world traveler as your guide, as we seek to understand our changing relationship with animals. With food, tradition, and innovation as our touchstones, we'll see what it means to leave behind exploitation in favor of compassion and kinship.

results.title: Try Your Luck
results.overview: As a woman enters the elevator of her building, she finds a die lying on a board on top of a pedestal with the phrase TRY YOUR LUCK engraved on it. She soon realizes that it is only by using the die, and not the elevator buttons, that she can move between floors.
